svg.title: NightRoll system architecture
svg.desc: The student phone gathers proof and signs it, the request leaves through the room access point, the FastAPI backend runs six hard gates then five scores to reach a verdict, backed by a face worker, Supabase, Upstash Redis and Google Play Integrity, and the warden dashboard shows the result live.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Hostel attendance marked from bed. One request has to prove three things at once.
Keystore key signs a one-time nonce

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: VPN, proxy, mock location · stops before the camera
blink, turn, smile chosen by the server · ML Kit
quality pre-check on the phone · VisionCamera, TFLite
BSSID, RSSI and band of nearby access points
bound to the SHA-256 of the payload
ECDSA P-256 · Android Keystore (StrongBox or TEE)
nonce, hashes of frames, scan, token, signature

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif
Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: SIX HARD GATES · ANY FAILURE REJECTS, NO SCORE IS CALCULATED
public key of the active device
no VPN, proxy or mock location
FIVE SCORES · EACH 0 TO 1, WEIGHTS ARE PROVISIONAL
VERDICT · ALWAYS WITH A REASON CODE
Also here: window scheduler (opens and closes on the server clock) · absentee recording ·
append-only audit log · JSON logs with secrets redacted

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: one window per room, one pane per bed
a room lights up as its students mark
set tonight's time, issue one-time codes
Sign-in: Supabase Auth, JWT with a TOTP
second step. Role: warden or admin.
VERDICT + PLAIN REASON BACK TO THE PHONE

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Silent-Face anti-spoof: live face or a photo?
Cosine similarity against the enrolled face

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Private frames bucket, deleted in 24 hours

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: One nonce per student per window
Consumed once by an atomic Lua script

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Token must match the payload hash
Package must be the NightRoll app

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Warden issues a one-time code, valid 15 minutes
Student reads the privacy notice and consents
Face → embedding stored, the photo is discarded
Phone creates its key, public key is stored
Room Wi-Fi scanned 3 times → room fingerprint
Android first. GPS is not used for the decision: the room's Wi-Fi is the fence.
Every automatic verdict can be overridden by the warden. The ground-floor scanner stays as the fallback.
